en.quote: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
en.riddle: These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: דַּבְּרוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֹאת הַֽחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכְלוּ מִכָּל־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ

en.1: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
en.2: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.

he.1: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
he.2: דַּבְּרוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֹאת הַֽחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכְלוּ מִכָּל־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

en.quote: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
en.riddle: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
en.speaker: the LORD
